effect_description_eng:
＜Jamming＞ (This Digimon can't be deleted in battles against Security Digimon.)
[On Play] [When Digivolving] Trash the top 2 digivolution cards of 1 of your opponent's Digimon. Then, 1 of their Digimon with as many or fewer digivolution cards as this Digimon can't suspend until their turn ends.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When this Digimon unsuspends, if you have 7 or fewer cards in your hand, ＜Draw 1＞ (Draw 1 card from your deck.)
